title: Time Series Structure Learning with Local Causal Parent Discovery
abstract: arXiv:2611.26232v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Learning and inference on time series can pose significant statistical challenges, including autocorrelated observations, distribution shift over time, and the curse of dimensionality. These challenges complicate the practical application of causal discovery algorithms, which already suffer from high computational and sample complexity in the general case. To mitigate these issues, this work introduces Iterative Temporal Parent Discovery (ITPD): a sound and complete constraint-based procedure for causal structure learning on multivariate time series with causal nonstationarity. ITPD takes a local-to-global learning approach that discovers the global graph by sequentially discovering the parent set for each variable. ITPD exploits temporal structural priors, graph partitioning, and the local Markov condition to swap higher-order conditional independence tests for lower-order alternatives. translated_title: 基于局部因果父节点发现的时间序列结构学习
translated_abstract: 时间序列上的学习与推断会带来重大的统计挑战，包括观测值的自相关性、随时间变化的分布偏移以及维数灾难。这些挑战使因果发现算法难以投入实际应用，而这类算法在一般情况下本已存在高计算复杂度与高样本复杂度的问题。为缓解这些问题，本工作提出了迭代时间父节点发现（ITPD）：一种针对具有因果非平稳性的多变量时间序列的可靠且完备的基于约束的因果结构学习程序。ITPD 采用局部到全局的学习方法，通过依次发现每个变量的父节点集合来构建全局图。ITPD 利用时间结构先验、图划分和局部马尔可夫条件，将高阶条件独立性检验替换为低阶替代检验。在精确神谕（oracle）下，ITPD 执行了最少次数的……
tldr: 该论文提出ITPD——一种可靠且完备的基于约束的因果结构学习方法，通过局部到全局的因果父节点发现来学习具有因果非平稳性的多变量时间序列结构，并借助时间结构先验与图划分将高阶条件独立性检验替换为低阶检验，从而降低计算与样本复杂度。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes ITPD, a sound and complete constraint-based method that learns causal structures of multivariate time series with causal nonstationarity via local-to-global causal parent discovery, leveraging temporal structural priors and graph partitioning to replace higher-order conditional independence tests with lower-order alternatives for reduced computational and sample complexity.
